summary: Local evidence reconciles without fabricated truth, score normalization, selected answers or phantom SQL results. Current EAD1 numbers and ordinary-control results are supported; scope/version qualifications remain. The initially ambiguous frontier-zero wording was corrected and rechecked.
actual_returned_backend_identity: unavailable; spawn exposed only canonical task name
reviewer_model: fresh Codex subagent; exact backend unverified
evaluation_details: Authored deterministic billing worlds with logged external LLM calls and real local SQLite commits; not independent real-world benchmark data.

ground_truth_provenance.details: Authored provider fee rules supply private post-commit truth; real saved LLM responses do not create truth. All 242 source actor payloads and all 16 EAD1 requests exclude private truth/world keys. inputs.json contains private reference batches, but branch() passes only system and payload to the client.

score_normalization.details: Ratios use declared planned-order/exact-quote/no-exact-quote denominators, not a model maximum. SAP totals are 286 correct, 3 wrong, 191 deferred out of 480; 280 exact-quote opportunities are all correct.

input_only_eligibility.details: Independently reconstructed all 40 quota-eligible states and all 8 selected cases from original decision inputs, including sorted order and minimum candidate index. No private outcome enters the selection predicate. The frozen selector ignores source_version, but all 40 states use tariff-17, so version-aware selection is identical on this batch.

matched_control_and_access.details: Every fresh control has byte-identical model messages to its original SAP decision request. Every retarget request differs only in new_reference_quote; system, orders, history, memory, planning recommendation and other request parameters match. All branches have one current quote and one new first response. Provider quote value independently matches the authored fee rule.

first_responses_and_sql_commits.details: All 16 EAD1 raw outputs match logged first responses; 16 unique provider response IDs, no retries. Only 2 branches project object arrays, preserving order IDs and all values. Every branch event sequence, current invoice commit, private score and target result matches its SQLite database. The 242-entry SAP adapter journal also preserves all 210 old replies plus 32 previously unanswered calls; 19 source structural projections preserve values.

whole_batch_and_paired_effects.details: Every planned 8-order batch is accounted for. Fresh 45/4/15 versus retarget 40/3/21 correct/wrong/deferred, each out of 64. Target correct increases 2 to 6, target wrong falls 4 to 2; other correct falls 43 to 34, other wrong rises 0 to 1. No retarget pair Pareto-dominates on the declared correct/wrong/deferred, quote and call dimensions. No conclusion of universal inferiority under arbitrary weighted utility is implied.

freeze_count_and_cost.details: All 8 EAD1 and 7 control freeze entries match current bytes. EAD1 schedule contains exactly 16 unique branches and all are received/executed. Response creation times follow freeze. Frozen-rate arithmetic reproduces USD 0.002117826, under the USD 0.05 cap; 28,076 prompt and 484 completion tokens. Controls make zero model calls; 48 SQLite trajectories contain 96 quote-method calls (48 prefix replays plus 48 current quotes). Price accuracy and provider billing were not externally certified.

exact_quote_and_stale_handling.details: Metric exact_quote_present requires both context and source_version; stale and context-mismatch calibration controls behave correctly. However EAD1 selection and World.quote_cache key context only, and analyze.py adds the current query without a version check. This has no observed effect because every source/current quote is tariff-17. It does not establish safe multi-version reuse or stale-current-quote overlay.

ordinary_fixed_response_controls.details: All 48 control SQLite trajectories and result records reconcile. All 16 original-response replays reproduce original private scores. Overlay preserves every value except 2 explicitly exact-quoted target values; fresh stays 45/4/15 and retarget becomes 42/1/21. Conservative exact-cache policy gives 40/0/24 in both branches and changes 14 values across all 16 branches. These are offline fixed-response controls, not new model rollouts or learning.

metric_calling_and_sensitivity.details: evaluate_opportunity is used on all 480 SAP and 128 EAD1 opportunity records; dominates is used on all 8 pairs. Recomputed all flags. Authored calibration returns 13/13 and is explicitly labeled ENGINEERING_SENSITIVITY_CONTROLS_NOT_MODEL_FINDINGS. Causal memory/source-attribution/revision fields remain unavailable, not successful zeros. Proposed adapters are local baselines or capability-declared bridge-only interfaces.

scope_and_documentation.details: New charter/registry correctly identify exploratory authored states, ordinary baselines, adverse whole-batch tradeoff and no established persistent-learning effect. The frontier-zero statement has been corrected to the note_frontier arm quota-eligible steps, consistent with its zero activation; f1-w0-note_natural round 1 has frontier_indices=[4]. Prior M7/28-4 assets and external citations/SDK documentation are outside the factual verification scope.

warnings.details: Initial frontier-zero wording was corrected in both registry files to specify the note_frontier arm quota-eligible steps. Re-read current docs and confirmed this matches source traces. One activation exists in note_natural, outside that arm-specific claim.
warnings.effect_on_numbers: None for EAD1 or note_frontier-specific conclusion.

warnings.details: No multi-version/stale-source run exists; frozen EAD selection/cache and current-quote overlay are not fully guarded for varying versions. Do not infer stale-version safety from metric calibration.
warnings.effect_on_numbers: All observed quotes use tariff-17; reconstructed current metrics and eligibility are unchanged.

warnings.details: Posthoc development selection, one fresh response per branch, eight related states from two authored families. No independent histories, model diversity, durable revision intervention or later-session EAD test. Same-family audit remains provisional; no novelty certification.

48 control_business_replays means SQLite trajectories, not total tool invocations: 96 quote() method calls, 264 current-batch invoice commits and 792 total invoice rows including reconstructed history. These do not add logical current-quote quota or external API calls.

claim_impact.natural_exact_quote_model_failure: Unsupported by SAP1: 0/280; the 2 observed exact-quote errors are EAD1 retarget intervention outcomes.
claim_impact.target_improvement: Supported locally: 2 to 6 correct out of 8, accompanied by non-target losses.
claim_impact.whole_batch_scheduler_improvement: Not established: completion falls, deferral rises, no paired Pareto dominance.
claim_impact.ordinary_binding_fixes_two_exact_quote_e: Supported as fixed-response offline replay; one unquoted non-target error remains.
claim_impact.persistent_memory_learning: Unobservable/unestablished by EAD1 and ordinary controls.
